Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 21-Dec-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Extended Reality Technologies [NPT_4135]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                What is the fundamental difference between Mixed Reality (MR) and Augmented Reality (AR)?             (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                      Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           What is the key characteristic of Spatial Audio that differentiates it from normal stereo sound?      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Discuss its four key components of Virtual Reality. Provide real-world examples to illustrate each    (5)  
  component.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                What is the primary function of a Three-Dimensional Position Tracker?                                 (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                      Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Categorize is the key principle behind the "Lighthouse" tracking approach used by devices like the    (3)  
  Valve Index?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Illustrate the problem of "drift" in IMU-based tracking and describe how a typical VR system          (5)  
  compensates for it using a technique like sensor fusion.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Briefly explain what an Animation State Machine is used for.                                          (2)  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Briefly explain how a multiple-camera infrared tracking system (like the HTC Vive) works.             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)           Describe the process of setting up a simple AR experience using the Vuforia SDK. Your answer          (5)  
  should include at least three key steps, from target creation to content display.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

4)                        List out the primary cause of Simulator Sickness in VR users?                                        (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                              Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                How does a "Lighthouse" tracking system differ from a traditional infrared tracking system that uses (3)  
  cameras?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Differentiate between Rigidbody and Collider in Unity. Why are both necessary? List the different    (5)  
  types of Colliders?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        What is the primary purpose of using Inverse Kinematics in avatar tracking?                          (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Write the key principle behind the "Lighthouse" tracking approach?                                   (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Write the main challenges associated with Outdoor Tracking for XR experiences? Discuss at least      (5)  
  two specific challenges.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
